name: zerotrustx-mern
description: ZeroTrustX – Zero Trust Enterprise Access Management System (MERN Stack)

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "API,UI" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
